## File: huggingface_transformers/tests/models/minimax_m2/test_modeling_minimax_m2.py

Prompts

```
['test the MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM model to verify aux_loss computation and padding token handling with router logits', 'test the MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM model batched logits output against expected values for left and right padded inputs', 'test the MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM model text generation by decoding generated tokens with AutoTokenizer', 'review the MiniMaxM2ModelTester class that extends CausalLMModelTester and sets the base model class to MiniMaxM2Model', 'run the MiniMaxM2IntegrationTest suite to validate logits and generation against expected outputs on CUDA or XPU devices']
```
